title: Madhes drought and water crisis protest at Maitighar
scope: One youth-led public demonstration organized under a Madhes regional movement banner; no broader site aggregation.
organizer: Madhes Agriculture-Water Movement Struggle Committee (Himalayan Times); the prior unreceipted Kathmandu Post outcome describes a related Madhesh Krishi-Jal Aandolan banner, exact alias equivalence not independently established.

state_target.target: Federal and provincial Nepal governments responsible for drought relief, water and agriculture policy.
state_target.evidence: Receipt-compliant Himalayan Times report states protest sought government action and long-term measures.

demands_original: Long-term response to drought/water crisis, relief and cash compensation for farmers, drinking-water access, irrigation support, and Chure conservation.
participants_original: A prior unreceipted Kathmandu Post outcome reported approximately 100 activists, but the receipt-compliant Himalayan Times article gives no count.
threshold_50_evidence: Freshly receipted Himalayan Times confirms a gathering but no headcount. The approx. 100 estimate is from an earlier body open without fresh receipt and cannot clear the ≥50 threshold.

start_date.summary: Himalayan Times states the protest took place Friday Aug 1.

demands.summary: Long-term drought response, compensation/relief, agriculture and water access, Chure concerns.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Old ~100 estimate has no fresh receipt; fresh independent account gives no number.

notes: Government drought designation/monitoring mentioned by source is not coded as accommodation to this specific protest. Unreceipted report's approx. 100 estimate remains limited.
open_questions: Can a receipt-compliant event-specific crowd estimate establish ≥50?
Did the movement hold a follow-up gathering or reach an end after Aug 1?

title: Sugarcane farmers protest over reduced subsidy and arrears
location: Maitighar Mandala, Kathmandu; later report says farmer representatives met the agriculture minister, with ongoing peaceful protest planned through Aug 30.
scope: One organized farmer-protest campaign with a documented Aug 24 street gathering; no extra counts from arrival totals or district reach.
organizer: Sugarcane Producers Federation and Sugarcane Producers Farmers Committee, as named by receipt-compliant People's Review; later Kathmandu Post follow-up documents a Sugarcane Farmers Struggle Committee.

state_target.target: Government subsidy and agricultural price-setting policy.
state_target.evidence: Receipt-compliant People's Review directly reports demand to pay prior subsidy at NPR 70 per quintal; Kathmandu Post follow-up reports minister meeting/assurance.

demands_original: Pay the previously promised NPR 70 per quintal subsidy and involve farmers in price determination; oppose reduced NPR 35 subsidy and seek payment of arrears.
participants_original: Onlinekhabar's earlier unreceipted body outcome gave approx. 500–600; Kathmandu Post's receipt-compliant follow-up says >1,000 growers had arrived in Kathmandu, which is not a simultaneous site count.
threshold_50_evidence: No fresh-receipted contemporaneous count at one gathering. The earlier 500–600 estimate was in an open without a fresh receipt; >1,000 arrivals do not establish simultaneous attendance at Maitighar. Threshold remains unverified.

start_date.summary: People's Review dates the Maitighar demonstration Aug 24; Post reports follow-up activity.

organizer.summary: Federation and farmers' committee named; committee names differ between reports and are preserved without assuming they are identical.

demands.summary: Subsidy restoration/payment and farmer consultation in price determination.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The 500–600 report is from an open without a receipt; >1,000 is an arrival count, not a site count.

state_response.summary: Agriculture Minister met representatives and assured full subsidy; actual payment and implementation unknown.

notes: Do not infer turnout from national farmer reach, committee membership, or arrivals. The August 26 minister meeting is evidence of a linked meeting/assurance only, not completed accommodation.
open_questions: What was simultaneous turnout at the Aug 24 Maitighar demonstration from a properly receipted source?
Did protest continue after the committee's stated Aug 30 plan, and was subsidy actually paid?

title: Sugarcane farmers reportedly burn tyres near mills
location: In front of unspecified sugar mills in Nepal; exact sites unknown.
scope: A separate earlier protest action reported retrospectively in a freshly receipted Aug 26 story; not pooled with Aug 24 Maitighar gathering.
organizer: Sugarcane farmers; exact local organizer unknown.

state_target.evidence: Report links it to the farmer subsidy campaign but does not identify the specific target at the tyre-burning sites.

demands_original: Context suggests the sugarcane subsidy issue, but specific demand and target at the Aug 4 action are not directly described.

location.summary: In front of sugar mills; exact sites not named.

state_target.summary: Direct target at the separate action is not specified.

notes: Retrospective report supports action occurrence but not exact geography, public attendance, or state target.
open_questions: Which mills/sites were involved and what was the direct target of the action?
Was there a public gathering of ≥50 at any one site?

title: Confederation of Nepali Teachers begins School Education Bill protest program
location: Kathmandu Valley party offices and district education-development/coordination units; precise sites and attendance unknown.
scope: CNT first phase of a multi-site teacher protest program, with common bill amendment demand; onset date mapped from the source's Sunday wording and Sep 2 publication date.

state_target.target: Nepal government and education-policy makers; party headquarters were also used as pressure sites.
state_target.evidence: Receipt-compliant Himal Press body says the first phase pressed the government to revise the Bill in line with agreements.

demands_original: Amend the School Education Bill in line with past agreements.

start_date.summary: Article published Sep 2 describes protests on Sunday (Aug 31), Monday (Sep 1), and Tuesday (Sep 2); Aug 31 derived by calendar mapping.

location.summary: Party offices in Kathmandu Valley and district education units across the country.

demands.summary: Amend School Education Bill per past agreements.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendee counts at any site; don't aggregate district units.

notes: One shared national program is plausible because CNT, teacher group and common demand are stated, but no site-specific count; reviewer should assess unitization and whether the multi-site program meets the threshold under the codebook.
open_questions: What were simultaneous attendance counts at any protest site?
Does the reported CNT program qualify as one national event or multiple local actions under codebook rules?
